description:
Deferred decision. workshop/save currently takes a full round JSON. The sync skill does fetch-patch-save per answer, which is fine but adds a round-trip and is theoretically racy if multiple sessions hit the same round simultaneously.

If the pattern feels clunky during sync-skill implementation, land a dedicated POST /api/v1/backlog/{kind}/{name}/workshop/rounds/{N}/items/{id}/answer endpoint that patches a single Selected/Freeform value server-side.

No action unless implementation of the sync skill (execute/workshop-decision-sync-skill) surfaces a concrete problem — this item tracks the deferred decision, not committed work.
